head.description: MCR Woodworks LLC, Miami FL: custom tables, desks and furniture in solid wood for restaurants, offices and homes. 5.0 stars on Google, 14 reviews. Call (786) 202-4145.
head.og_description: 5.0 stars on Google, 14 reviews. Custom tables, desks and furniture in solid wood, built to order.

jsonld.name: MCR Woodworks LLC
jsonld.description: Custom woodworking company in Miami, FL: solid wood tables, tabletops, desks and furniture for restaurants, offices and homes.

parrafo.es: MCR Woodworks fabrica mesas, tableros, escritorios y muebles de madera maciza desde su taller en el centro de Miami. Sus clientes en Google destacan la atención directa de Mike, la rapidez de entrega y un acabado que aguanta el uso diario de un restaurante.
parrafo.en: MCR Woodworks builds tables, tabletops, desks and solid wood furniture out of its workshop in downtown Miami. Their Google reviewers point to Mike's direct attention, fast turnaround and a finish that holds up to daily use in a restaurant.

hero.imagen_alt: Mesa redonda de madera maciza fabricada por MCR Woodworks en el salón de un restaurante con lámpara de cristal

parrafo_1.es: MCR Woodworks, liderada por Mike, fabrica mesas, tableros, escritorios y muebles de madera maciza a medida para restaurantes, oficinas y casas en Miami y alrededores.
parrafo_1.en: MCR Woodworks, led by Mike, builds custom tables, tabletops, desks and solid wood furniture for restaurants, offices and homes around Miami.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google destacan un trato directo con Mike, precios justos y un acabado que resiste el uso diario, al punto de manejar hasta Nueva Jersey para dejar una entrega exactamente como debía ser.
parrafo_2.en: Their Google reviewers point to dealing directly with Mike, fair pricing and a finish that holds up to daily use, to the point of driving all the way to New Jersey to leave a delivery exactly the way it should be.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué necesitas (mesas, escritorio, mobiliario completo) y coordinamos los detalles.
texto.en: Tell us what you need (tables, a desk, a full furniture set) and we work out the details.

texto.es: Elegimos juntos la madera, el tamaño y el acabado que encajan con tu espacio.
texto.en: We pick the wood, size and finish that fit your space together.

texto.es: Construimos cada pieza en nuestro taller, cuidando el corte y el acabado.
texto.en: We build every piece in our workshop, with care in every cut and finish.

texto.es: Entregamos e instalamos, incluso fuera de Florida cuando el proyecto lo pide.
texto.en: We deliver and set up, even outside Florida when the job calls for it.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el proyecto. Llámanos y te damos el detalle.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the project. Call us and we will walk you through it.

texto.es: Tableros de madera maciza para restaurantes y cafés, hechos al tamaño y acabado que necesitas.
texto.en: Solid wood tabletops for restaurants and cafes, built to the size and finish you need.

texto.es: Escritorios y muebles para casa u oficina, en la madera y el acabado exacto que buscas.
texto.en: Desks and furniture for your home or office, in the exact wood and finish you are after.

texto.es: Mesas y sillas completas para restaurantes, cafés y oficinas, con opciones listas en nuestro showroom.
texto.en: Full sets of tables and chairs for restaurants, cafes and offices, with options ready in our showroom.

texto.es: Entregamos e instalamos tu pedido, incluso fuera de Florida cuando el proyecto lo requiere.
texto.en: We deliver and install your order, even outside Florida when the project calls for it.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Llámanos igual, lo cotizamos.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call us anyway and we will quote it.

subtitulo.es: Reseñas reales de clientes en Google.

items.quote: Michael was a great help at finding me the exact wood and finish I was looking for on my desk. Turn around was quick, pricing very fair and was able to deliver to my address.

Professional quality service. My tables I ordered came out amazing. MCR gave my restaurant a complete renovated feel an no longer have to deal with tablecloths. Excellently turn around time. Very efficient, great prices.
If I could give "infinite" stars, I would. Michael was fantastic to work with. You can tell he loves what he does and cares about the product he produces and that extends to his customers.

texto.es: Llámanos y te contamos qué podemos fabricar para ti.
texto.en: Call us and we will tell you what we can build for you.

texto.es: Visítanos en el centro de Miami o mira nuestras reseñas en Google.
texto.en: Visit us in downtown Miami or check our reviews on Google.

parrafo.es: Una llamada y coordinamos medidas, madera y acabado.
parrafo.en: One call and we set up size, wood and finish.
